verses.1: And Sarah lived for a hundred and twenty-seven years.
verses.2: Sarah died in the land of Kenaan. Then Abraham went to comfort Sarah and wept over her.
verses.3: And Abraham rose from his death’s bed and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying:
verses.4: I will dwell among you. Please give me a share of your possessions, and I will be able to leave this world before it happens to me.
verses.5: And the sons of Heth answered Abraham with these words:
verses.6: Hear us, O Lord God! You are among us in our choice. Be the one to take our dead bodies away from us. No one else can do this except you. Only you can take our dead bodies away from us.
verses.7: And Abraham stood up and bowed to the people of the land, to Beth-Echem.
verses.8: And he said to them, “If you have the heart to gather my dead before me, then listen to me. And do not hurt me with the arrow of Tzohar.”
verses.9: And I will be given the land of the inheritance that belongs to him. It’s located at the edge of the field, and it will be given to me as a possession for my use.
verses.10: And Efrôn sat among the sons of Jeth. Efrôn told Abraham everything that the sons of Jeth said to him, in every house within the city’s walls.
verses.11: I do not listen to your words, O wicked one! I have given you this place, and the valley where you will be located. I will give it to you for the eyes of my people to see. It will be a grave for you.
verses.12: And Abraham bowed down before the people of the earth.
verses.13: And he spoke to Efrón in the ears of the people of that land, saying, “But if you will listen to me, I will give you the money from the crop. Take it from me, and I will die in peace.”
verses.14: And Efron said to Abraham, “To you.”
verses.15: O Lord, hear me! The land between me and you is worth four shekels of silver. What is that to you? And your death is meaningless.
verses.16: And Abraham heard from Ephron. Then Abraham gave Ephron the money that was mentioned in the ears of the sons of Ket. The amount was four thousand shekels of silver, more than enough to buy a field.
verses.17: And he made the field of Ephron, which was located in front of the gate leading to the valley and the city within it. And all the trees that were in that field, and all the trees along its boundaries.
verses.18: For Abraham, for the sake of the children of Heth, in all the streets of the city.
verses.19: And after that, Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the valley of Shechem, on the other side of Mamre. It was in the land of Canaan.
verses.20: And the field and the city in which Abraham lived were given to him as a possession from the children of Heth.
